|game_text='''Light Side:''' Once per turn, if Kashyyyk was your starting location, may ▼ a Kashyyyk site.

'''Dark Side:''' Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of Kashyyyk (V), the text of the Virtual Block 5 release sheet; it is the current text. Other versions: [[Kashyyyk (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-75E-Kashyyyk.png]]), which shows this text. The first printing of September 2009 is lost; see the history below.
* '''First printing''' (September 2009): lost. The card was first issued when the Players Committee realigned its Virtual Sets into Virtual Blocks in September 2009<ref name="pc-news-2009-09-16">Players Committee news post “Virtual Set 6: Reflections 4 and Errata Released (Updated)”, 16 September 2009 (the Virtual Sets realigned into Virtual Blocks 1–5). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102746/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/news/news.php?id=70 Internet Archive]</ref>. No copy of that first printing survives, so its text is not known and it has no page here (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kashyyyk (V) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif]], slip number 75E, errata mark E) prints: “'''Light Side:''' Once per turn, if this was your starting location, may ▼ a Kashyyyk site. '''Dark Side:''' Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-r1">Lee Edwards' Star Wars CCG V-kit (swccgvkit-legacy), slip image <code>public/images/vslips/virtual16-light/kashyyyk.png</code> (slip #75E), in Subversion revision 1, committed 9 December 2009 (<code>.svn/entries</code>; [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips GitHub copy])</ref>, so it was made by then. The PC website card list gives no text for this location, but it stamps the errata'd Virtual Block 5 cards (for example [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata 3)|Let's Go Left (V)]]) “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”; this wording is that errata of 9 September 2009 (versions ruling of 11 November 2026). It is the earliest surviving text of the card.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009) changed “if this was your starting location” to “if Kashyyyk was your starting location” (the Dark Side text is the same): “'''Light Side:''' Once per turn, if Kashyyyk was your starting location, may ▼ a Kashyyyk site. '''Dark Side:''' Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 75E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-75E-Kashyyyk.png]]) shows this text. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=41, page 41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=41 Internet Archive]</ref>, so it is the current text. The PC website card list (2012–13) gives no game text for this location, so it has no card-list version.
